risks.title: Fluctuations in yen/dollar foreign exchange rates
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned prominently in the Risk Factors section and detailed extensively in Item 7A. The company is significantly exposed through its Japan operations and substantial yen-denominated investments. Exchange rate fluctuations directly impact the translation of yen-denominated assets/liabilities into USD for reporting, and the company notes potential for significant cash strain at the parent company level from derivative settlements and collateral requirements. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Fluctuations in the yen/dollar exchange rate impact the value of Aflac Japan's yen-denominated assets and liabilities when translated to USD for financial reporting, and can create significant liquidity requirements for derivative settlements and collateral, particularly during yen strengthening periods.

risks.title: Interest rate risk on fixed income investments
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate risk is identified as a primary market risk factor affecting the company's investment portfolio. The company holds a significant portion of fixed maturity securities which are sensitive to rate changes. Item 7A explicitly identifies this as one of the primary market risks monitored regularly. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Changes in interest rates affect the fair value of the company's substantial portfolio of fixed maturity securities, potentially impacting investment returns and the company's financial position.

risks.title: Credit risk on fixed income securities
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates that a significant portion of the investment portfolio is composed of fixed maturity securities, exposing the company to counterparty credit risk. The company monitors credit risk through various strategies, suggesting material exposure. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: A substantial portion of Aflac's investment portfolio consists of fixed maturity securities and loans, creating exposure to credit risk from potential defaults by underlying issuers and borrowers.

risks.title: Geographic concentration of investments in Japan
risks.score_rationale: The company's Japan segment generates the vast majority of earnings and the investment portfolio shows significant concentration in yen-denominated securities. The MD&A indicates that Aflac Japan's functional currency is the yen and a material portion of the portfolio supports yen-denominated liabilities, creating concentration risk. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Aflac Japan represents the company's primary profit driver, and a material portion of the investment portfolio is concentrated in yen-denominated and Japan-based securities, creating vulnerability to Japan-specific economic conditions.

risks.title: Derivative and hedging program risks
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A details extensive use of foreign currency forwards, options, and other derivatives for hedging purposes. The company acknowledges rollover risk, basis risk, and the potential for significant derivative losses during periods of yen movement. The company notes explicit risks from shorter-duration derivatives hedging longer-duration investments. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Aflac uses foreign currency derivatives and hedging instruments to manage currency exposure, but these instruments introduce rollover risk, collateral requirements, and potential settlement losses, particularly during volatile currency movements.

risks.title: Liquidity strain from foreign exchange derivatives settlement
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A explicitly states that if yen strengthens significantly, this could cause cash strain at the parent company from derivative cash settlements and collateral requirements, and notes this could be significant depending on timing and severity of rate movements. The company manages this through ongoing hedging program adjustments. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Aflac's use of foreign currency derivatives to hedge yen exposure can create significant temporary liquidity demands at the parent company level during periods of yen strengthening, requiring cash for collateral and settlement obligations.

company_description: Aflac Incorporated, through its subsidiaries, provides supplemental health and life insurance products. It operates in two segments, Aflac Japan and Aflac U.S. The Aflac Japan segment offers cancer, medical, nursing care, whole life, and GIFT insurance products, as well as WAYS and child endowment, and Tsumitasu insurance products in Japan. Its Aflac U.S. segment provides accident, disability, cancer, critical illness, hospital indemnity, dental, vision, and life insurance products in the United States. The company also provides hearing, final expense, pet, Medicare supplement, supplemental dental and vision, short-term disability, and absence management insurance products, as well as cafeteria plans. It sells its products to individuals, families, and business owners through individual, independent corporate, and affiliated corporate agencies; banks; independent associates/career agents; and brokers. Aflac Incorporated was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Columbus, Georgia.

fr.activity: Aflac est une société d'assurance qui propose des assurances complémentaires pour aider les gens à payer les frais de santé non couverts par leur assurance principale.
fr.products: Ses produits incluent des assurances hospitalisation, des assurances accidents, des assurances maladies graves et des assurances dentaires.
fr.customers: Ses clients sont des particuliers et des employés d'entreprises qui souhaitent une protection financière supplémentaire en cas de problème de santé ou d'accident.
fr.edge: Aflac est forte grâce à sa marque très connue, surtout au Japon, et sa capacité à proposer des assurances qui complètent les couvertures existantes, offrant une sécurité financière en cas d'imprévus.

en.activity: Aflac is an insurance company that provides supplemental insurance to help people cover out-of-pocket medical expenses not paid by their primary insurance.
en.products: Its products include hospitalization insurance, accident insurance, critical illness insurance, and dental insurance.
en.customers: Its customers are individuals and employees of companies who want additional financial protection in case of health issues or accidents.
en.edge: Aflac is strong due to its well-recognized brand, especially in Japan, and its ability to offer insurance that complements existing coverage, providing financial security for unexpected events.

de.activity: Aflac ist ein Versicherungsunternehmen, das Zusatzversicherungen anbietet, um Menschen bei der Deckung von medizinischen Kosten zu unterstützen, die nicht von ihrer Hauptversicherung übernommen werden.
de.products: Zu den Produkten gehören Krankenhausversicherungen, Unfallversicherungen, Dread-Disease-Versicherungen und Zahnversicherungen.
de.customers: Zu den Kunden gehören Privatpersonen und Firmenmitarbeiter, die zusätzlichen finanziellen Schutz bei gesundheitlichen Problemen oder Unfällen wünschen.
de.edge: Aflac ist stark durch seine bekannte Marke, insbesondere in Japan, und seine Fähigkeit, Versicherungen anzubieten, die bestehende Deckungen ergänzen und finanzielle Sicherheit bei unvorhergesehenen Ereignissen bieten.

fr.positioning: Aflac se positionne comme un leader de l'assurance complémentaire et des avantages sociaux volontaires, opérant principalement aux États-Unis et au Japon. Elle concurrence des acteurs comme Unum, Lincoln National et MetLife, en se distinguant par une forte présence sur le marché japonais via des produits de niche.
fr.tech_products: Aflac utilise des plateformes numériques pour la gestion des polices et des sinistres, ainsi que des outils d'analyse de données pour personnaliser les offres. Ses produits clés incluent des assurances maladies graves et des indemnités journalières d'hospitalisation, souvent distribuées via des employeurs.
fr.moat: L'avantage concurrentiel d'Aflac repose sur sa marque très forte et sa reconnaissance au Japon, un marché où elle a établi une position dominante. Elle bénéficie également de coûts de commutation élevés pour les employeurs qui intègrent ses solutions d'avantages sociaux, et d'une expertise reconnue dans la gestion des risques spécifiques à l'assurance complémentaire.
fr.risks: Aflac est exposée au risque de change significatif en raison de ses vastes opérations au Japon, rendant ses résultats sensibles aux fluctuations du yen. De plus, sa dépendance aux canaux de distribution via les employeurs la rend vulnérable aux changements dans les politiques d'avantages sociaux des entreprises et à la concurrence intense sur ce segment.

en.positioning: Aflac positions itself as a leader in supplemental insurance and voluntary benefits, operating primarily in the United States and Japan. It competes with players like Unum, Lincoln National, and MetLife, distinguishing itself with a strong presence in the Japanese market through niche products.
en.tech_products: Aflac utilizes digital platforms for policy and claims management, along with data analytics tools to customize offerings. Its key products include critical illness insurance and daily hospitalization indemnity, often distributed through employers.
en.moat: Aflac's competitive advantage stems from its very strong brand and recognition in Japan, a market where it has established a dominant position. It also benefits from high switching costs for employers integrating its voluntary benefits solutions, and recognized expertise in managing risks specific to supplemental insurance.
en.risks: Aflac is exposed to significant currency exchange risk due to its extensive operations in Japan, making its results sensitive to yen fluctuations. Furthermore, its reliance on employer-based distribution channels makes it vulnerable to changes in corporate benefits policies and intense competition in this segment.

de.positioning: Aflac positioniert sich als führender Anbieter von Zusatzversicherungen und freiwilligen Leistungen, hauptsächlich in den Vereinigten Staaten und Japan. Das Unternehmen konkurriert mit Akteuren wie Unum, Lincoln National und MetLife und zeichnet sich durch eine starke Präsenz auf dem japanischen Markt mit Nischenprodukten aus.
de.tech_products: Aflac nutzt digitale Plattformen für die Verwaltung von Policen und Schadenfällen sowie Datenanalysetools zur Personalisierung von Angeboten. Zu den Schlüsselprodukten gehören Dread-Disease-Versicherungen und Krankenhaustagegeldversicherungen, die oft über Arbeitgeber vertrieben werden.
de.moat: Aflacs Wettbewerbsvorteil beruht auf seiner sehr starken Marke und Anerkennung in Japan, einem Markt, auf dem es eine dominante Position etabliert hat. Es profitiert auch von hohen Wechselkosten für Arbeitgeber, die seine freiwilligen Leistungslösungen integrieren, sowie von anerkannter Expertise im Management spezifischer Risiken der Zusatzversicherung.
de.risks: Aflac ist aufgrund seiner umfangreichen Geschäftstätigkeit in Japan einem erheblichen Wechselkursrisiko ausgesetzt, was seine Ergebnisse anfällig für Yen-Schwankungen macht. Darüber hinaus macht die Abhängigkeit von Arbeitgeber-basierten Vertriebskanälen das Unternehmen anfällig für Änderungen in den Unternehmensleistungspolitiken und intensiven Wettbewerb in diesem Segment.
